desc: When you're hunting or target shooting far downrange, every detail and every fraction of an inch counts. The Patriot LR Hunter has such features to help with those details. Its stock with precise contours is ideal for comfort and accuracy. The Monte Carlo elevated comb works in combination with the optics top rail to make sighting easy, keeping you reliably-on target. And, the stock utilizes a special coating process for a full-rifle micro-textured surface that provides a comfortable, firm hold in the field or at the range.
